gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-ranade: Happy Monkey looks like one length of tubing bent into letters, loud and unmistakable at display size. And Ranade, the sans-serif below, does its best work with a slight stroke swell and widely spaced letter endings.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-general-sans: General Sans fills its lines with a high lowercase and steady pressure, with curves that nothing snags on. And under a Happy Monkey heading, a full page of it would read smoothly, without a single bump.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic, approachable and sans-serif, sets its stroke ends far apart and keeps every letter uniform in weight. And what stands out most is Happy Monkey's bold, wide-gapped display look, set against that unhurried one-letter-at-a-time reading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-syncopate: Ruler-straight strokes and wide gaps inside the e give Happy Monkey its bold look, with Syncopate underneath drawn like technical-pen work. Give Syncopate a little extra size for its rope-ladder spacing.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-manrope: Happy Monkey draws every stroke with a ruler-straight, bold weight and wide gaps. Best of all, Manrope's bright curve openings and higher lowercase sit comfortably against that loud, wide-gapped display face.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-aldrich: Loud and level, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its terminals pointing outward, over Aldrich. Give it large, brief lines and let Aldrich's cupped rounds handle the rest.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-alexandr: Alexandria has wide-mouthed c terminals and a generous lowercase body with short stems above and below the line. Love Ya Like A Sister adds flat, sign-painter weight on top.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-anek-ban: Love Ya Like A Sister bends neon-tube letters of constant thickness, with ascenders that barely clear the x-height. Anek Bangla, with wide s curves and a short midline-to-ascender rise, would read smoothly across paragraphs.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-anek-dev: Anek Devanagari reads openly, its letter mouths wide and its middle zone lofty. And against the technical-pen line of Love Ya Like A Sister, that openness is the thing that stands out most.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-anek-kan: Contemporary but blunt, Love Ya Like A Sister traces its low letters as if with a single marker tip. Anek Kannada rises high with woodblock squareness, and its far-set terminals give the page breathing room beside it.
